- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the benefits of packing cubes, including organization, compression, visibility, and portion control.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the benefits of packing rolls, including rolling clothes, space-saving, organization, and protection.
